notes: Portuguese read by a Spanish speaker. Uses the shared per-sense engine and Spanish English-glossed Wiktionary extract, with Portuguese in column 0 of CogNet por-spa. Regular nh/ñ, lh/ll and nominal endings are aligned. Shared English glosses and the Spanish word's primary reading are required; every shown sense must qualify before a card is skipped. Minimum length 3 and conservative initial cutoff 0.80. Built against pt-speech-v23-10000x30-slim on 2026-10-08 using enwiktionary-2026-09-13 Spanish: 4,257/10,000 cards qualify, including 40/300 first cards. Checked informação/información, família/familia, cidade/ciudad; oficina and esquisito do not qualify. This is an initial cutoff, not a comprehensive manual calibration; dictionary coverage and inherited inflection glosses limit matching precision.
